title: Mexican Paella with Oysters
description: A twist on the classic Spanish paella, this Mexican version features succulent oysters and a warm, spicy flavor.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Red onion adds a sweet flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Use fire-roasted tomatoes for added smokiness

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Use cumin for a classic Mexican flavor

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: Adds a smoky depth to the paella

ingredients.name: Paella Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade spice blend

instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add chorizo sausage and cook until browned, about 2 minutes.
Add onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until coated in oil and slightly toasted.
Add diced tomatoes, cumin, smoked paprika, and paella spice blend.
Stir to combine, then add chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add oysters to the pan, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes, until rice is cooked and oysters are heated through.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
